company.shortDescription: Facilio Inc. is an enterprise SaaS company that offers a unified cloud platform to make buildings operationally efficient.
company.description:
Facilio Inc. is an enterprise SaaS company that offers a unified cloud platform to make buildings operationally efficient. Its IoT and AI-driven property operations & facilities management platform allows real estate owners to aggregate building data, optimize performance, and control portfolio operations - all from one place.
					
Customers in the commercial office, healthcare, higher education & retail industries use Facilio to manage a cumulative 25,000 buildings located across North America, Europe & UK, the Middle East, Australia, and the Asia Pacific. Global real-estate brands such as ICD Brookefield, BritishLand UK, Aster Hospitals, and Investa Property Group use Facilio to reduce portfolio operations costs, increase net asset values, derisk operational liability and optimize energy savings. 

Headquartered in New York City with offices in Dubai, Chennai, Singapore, and Sydney, Facilio is a global company backed by leading investors including Accel India, Tiger Global Management, Dragoneer Investment Group, and Brookfield Growth.
